title: Package Details Conversion UX
outcome: Prospective customers can compare same-origin departure dates, inspect operator-authored package facts, choose a supported adult room and guest combination, understand the full authoritative payment commitment and continue to booking directly from Package Details without invented commercial or itinerary facts.
actor: Unauthenticated prospective customers evaluating a published NoorPath Umrah departure before booking.
modules: Catalogue remains authoritative for published package, stay, route, inclusion and exclusion facts.
Pricing remains authoritative for immutable occupancy price and snapshotted payment-plan arithmetic.
Inventory remains authoritative for current room availability and sibling sold-out state.
Operators remains authoritative for public operator eligibility and identity.
The web application renders the approved NoorPath Package visual language and never calculates commercial values client-side.
routes: Package Details -> available same-origin sibling date -> /packages/{siblingDepartureId}.
Package Details -> adult guests and room sharing -> server-authored payment summary.
Package Details -> Milestone or Pay Later summary -> complete pre-booking breakdown.
Package Details -> Book now -> existing /packages/{departureId}/plan flow with occupancy and paymentMode preserved.
acceptance: Same-origin sibling departures are chronological, current date is highlighted and sold-out dates remain visible but disabled.
Adult guest and room-sharing choices expose only supported current adult occupancy combinations.
Total, minimum today, remaining and future payment values come from server-authoritative immutable published pricing and payment-plan state.
Milestone view and Pay Later summary reconcile to the same published commercial commitment and final deadline without inventing a second pricing policy.
Journey presentation uses only persisted operator departure, stay and travel facts.
Standard Package, Travel Kit, Umrah Kit and Not Included items use NoorPath semantic icons.
Confirmed and pending facts plus cancellation and payment disclosures remain factual and visible before booking.
Book now preserves occupancy and payment-mode selection into the existing planner route.
Public error, unavailable and retry behaviour remains safe and no private pricing, version or account identifiers leak.
Desktop, mobile, 200-percent-text and reduced-motion rendered checks pass with keyboard focus, 44px targets, axe and no viewport horizontal overflow.
Child and infant pricing or configuration, detailed itinerary persistence, authentication-flow changes and production deployment remain out of scope.
exclusions: Child or infant eligibility, pricing, guest controls or operator configuration.
Multi-room family allocation beyond existing double, triple and quad adult rules.
A new Pay Later persistence model or change to existing quote, hold or payment execution semantics.
Detailed itinerary-step authoring or persistence not present in current Catalogue data.
Arbitrary custom icon persistence beyond the standard NoorPath content catalogue.
Customer phone OTP provider activation, Knowledge Pack work, airline or supplier integrations, promotions or discount engine, or production deployment.
